name: Market-clock books transferred to index futures
sample: 2015-01-01 through 2015-12-31 is warmup only; scored research dates are IF, IH, and IC from 2016-01-04 through 2021-12-31. Read only index research minute shards, index research fees, and index research roll-yield data. Do not read 2022 or 2026; do not read 2023-2025 locked partitions.
pool: Fixed equal-weight pool of IF, IH, and IC; split gross exposure by three instruments.

parameters.duration_threshold: 55th percentile of absolute one-minute price changes over the prior 250 trading days, excluding the current day
parameters.zscore: per instrument and factor, trailing 250 observations excluding the current day, minimum 125, clipped to +/-3
parameters.roll_yield: RiceQuant main_sub annualized_yield, lagged one trading day

execution.commission: historical index fees, by-money rate x1.01 and by-volume rate +0.01 CNY/lot
execution.slippage: one prior-year tick estimated from index minute data per side
execution.decision: close-known signal executed at the next trading day's first bar open; unchanged target keeps lots

reporting: Report both books and all six calendar-year results with costs. This is a transfer test, not parameter selection; do not tune or infer a deployable edge from this sample.
